required_manual_checks.description: Inspect migrations 006 through 009 and the current production prospect reader, including SQL object and policy dependencies, before selecting the minimum scratch-schema migration set. Explain why the chosen sequence supplies archived_at and every dependent object the real reader needs. Do not blindly append only migration 009 or alter any migration file.

Preserve the original barrier-based simultaneous-request proof, distinct backend/session checks, zero-crossover assertions, and thrown-request cleanup assertion. Exercise the real current reader; do not mock archived_at, bypass the reader, relax timing or concurrency assertions, or change authorization/session implementation.

Keep the negative barrier control and deliberately broken shared-slot mutant. In the focused run, show that the real implementation and negative barrier control pass while the shared-slot mutant is detected as leaking and fails as expected.

Limit production mutation to the suite's existing temporary scratch-schema lifecycle. Preserve teardown even when an assertion fails. Verify afterward with read-only inspection that the scratch schema is absent; do not touch production business data or vault data.

Run only request-isolation.test.ts in the controlled proof environment. Report exact passed, failed, and skipped counts, the barrier and shared-slot control outcomes, post-run scratch-schema cleanup, and clean git status. Do not run the full production DB gate unless this task contract explicitly requires it or claim a full gate receipt from a focused run.

Change only apps/os/tests/db/request-isolation.test.ts. Base the work on accepted DB-PROOF-001 and the promoted DB-PARITY-001 and DB-RESIDUE-001 baseline. Do not change runtime, Sales, authorization/session code, migrations, gate runner, Coordinator, vault data, or 2A.2d. Report remaining limitations and freeze/publish the exact candidate for Claude review; do not deploy.
